annotations.title: Read a section of the Virgin Islands Code

description: The full text of one section of the 2026 Virgin Islands Code by citation ("1 V.I.C. § 254") or by title and section, in windows of up to 40,000 characters. Use to read a section found by search_code. The text is an unofficial word-for-word copy of the 2026 edition as found, for reference, not for legal reliance, and every answer says so. It is returned inside a fence labelled as untrusted data.

limit.description: Characters to return. Default and maximum 40000.

offset.description: The next_offset value from the previous response.

section.description: With title: the section number, e.g. "254" or "2-101".

title.description: With section: the title, "1" to "34", "11A", "12A" or "15A".

name: get_code_section
title: Read a section of the Virgin Islands Code
